externalUsageEvidence.finding: Cambridge records get to the bottom of something as discovering the truth; the source uses gone to the bottom of it and needs a source-faithful re-lemma decision.

Cambridge labels in small doses an idiom meaning for short periods; source smaller doses is a comparative variant requiring exact context and time-versus-amount assessment.
Cambridge records fumble with for handling something awkwardly, supporting the source payment-handling sense, subject to the seven-step owner gate.
